title: Asymptotic regimes for maximum likelihood estimation in the Ewens--Pitman model: When the strength parameter matters
summary: We study the large sample asymptotic behaviour of the Maximum Likelihood Estimator of the discount and strength parameters $(α,θ)$ in the Ewens--Pitman model for random partitions, under mild assumptions on the data-generating mechanism. We show that four distinct regimes arise, depending on the limiting behaviour of the frequency spectrum. In particular, in contrast with previous work, we find that $θ$ may play a crucial role asymptotically.
